name: The Keepers' Rule
description: A Keeper's knot-cord and the charcoal lines copied beside it from a wall of the Unsung Vault.

name: A Page on the Vault Steps
description: A page of birch-bark left weighted with a stone on the Unsung Vault's top step, for whoever goes down.

name: The Goose-Count
description: Eune Mor's knotted withy cord of the geese at the fold, and a clerk's copy of it on a scrap of paper.

name: The Tide Turned Round
description: A strip of burial paper painted in indigo with the Flood-Callers' creed, pulled off the stakes' wall.

name: A Flood-Caller's Sounding
description: A bundle-tag wrapped in oilskin and pushed between the Drowned Bell Shrine's stones, written on the back in a shaking hand.

name: A Page from the Tally Book
description: A leaf torn from the back of the Eel Tally's book, the same rows written twice in two inks.

name: Hester's List
description: The covers of a Vale almanac with a list of names written inside them in pencil gone over in ink.

name: The Chair's Naming-Cord
description: A copy of the long indigo cord of names coiled on Isse's seat, as the tender reads it out.

name: The Leech-Wife's Ledger
description: A board copied from the chalk on the inside of a kennel door: leeches, hounds, and what happened to them.

name: The Pumping-Book
description: An engineer's brass-cornered book, swollen with damp, left open on the ledge by the Draining Mill's sluice.

name: Rubbings from the Drylanders' Hummock
description: Charcoal rubbings on reed paper of the grave-boards on the hummock west of Isseva.

name: The Bloomer's Cord
description: The bloomer's knotted tally of this spring's iron, cut from the furnace's wicker door.

name: The Row-Knots of the Grey Line
description: The knots of Nauvissa's sixty rows of stakes, read off and written down by the stake-drivers.

name: The Watchman's Log
description: The South Stilts watchman's birch-bark note for the Reed Council, which the Council never came to read.

name: A Rubbing from Isse's Stair
description: A soft charcoal rubbing of two inscriptions, one over the other, on the ninth step of the colonnade.

name: The Feeders' Tally
description: The cord the feeders hang from the Sallow King's lowest branch, out of reach of what they feed.

name: A Stews-Keeper's Note
description: A note folded small and wedged in the high pond's sluice-gate, addressed to the clerk at the Tally.

name: A Letter in the Chimney-Box
description: A letter wrapped round a string of eel-bone beads in the strongbox wedged up the drowned house's chimney.

name: The Cutters' Finds-Book
description: The peat-cutters' tally-board of things found in the peat, and what they are owed for each.

name: The Shrine's Keeping
description: A rubbing of the board cut under the Drowned Bell Shrine's Hearthstone, where the spray does not reach.

name: The Keeper's Lantern
description: A lantern of horn and alder older than Isseva, the horn gone the colour of honey. It is lit, and it does not want oil, and every lantern in the Unsung Vault was lit from it once. Held up, it throws the shadow of a hand that is not yours.

name: Cut Burial Lanterns
description: Nine bundles of nine burial lanterns, indigo paper on alder frames, each cut from its boat with the oil still in it and tagged by the Flood-Callers for the Drowned Bell. Every one was measured a spoonful of oil for a year of somebody's life.

name: A Lantern with a Vale Name
description: A burial lantern pegged in the Mor weave, indigo paper on alder, with a name painted round it in careful Vale letters by a hand that learned them for the purpose: HESTER WRENN.

name: The Trappers' Tally-Stick
description: A stick of ash rubbed black with handling, notched along four faces: every barrel of eels the Oulea trappers have sent up to the Tally for eleven years, counted the way the reedfolk counted before the Guild could write.

name: The Old Bitch's Collar
description: A hound's collar of iron links on a leather band, chewed through at the buckle and chewed again, as if the dog that wore it had tried to get it back on.
